title: Cornerstone Jobs Search output
description: The jobs found, one row per job in the default dataset (switch between the Jobs and Details views), plus a run summary record.

jobs.title: Jobs found (jobs)
jobs.description: Every saved job, newest first: title, company, locations, work type, posting date and job link, and with details on the description, address and apply link. Export as JSON, CSV or Excel.

summary.title: Run summary (summary)
summary.description: The OUTPUT record in the default key-value store: boards read, boards and companies with a match, jobs matched and saved, checked links, notes about how the input was read, and the settings used.
